description:
Problem: protocol.history() (protocol.py:290-307) keeps any benchbox-oracle[bot] review that is not DISMISSED and decodes its unsigned marker, without edit state; github.oracle_reviews (github.py:132-145) reads REST, which has no edit fields. A write-access account (GitHub's Write role can edit anyone's PR comments; oracle-review-v2.md:819-821 says agents share such an account) can edit an App review's marker to decision SHIP and patch_digest of a new unreviewed patch (computable offline via local.file_states + protocol.patch_digest). plan_round then CARRYs (protocol.py:412-428), report.carried posts a fresh unedited App review with this run's run id and a success status, and oracle-gate passes. Editing patch_map narrows a follow-up to a trivial file (changed_paths). Same root cause: soundness_merge_digest.py:252-270,415-425,482-485 decides oracle success from editable review bodies; dedup.open_fingerprints (dedup.py:33-49) trusts editable App inline-comment markers. The guard re-read (_reread_history, cli.py:935-953) returns an empty History after three failures.

Outcome: every reader of App-authored protocol state fails closed on edited or unreadable-edit-state objects. (1) oracle_reviews carries node_id; a batched GraphQL read of lastEditedAt/includesCreatedEdit (reuse oracle_review_check.fetch_review_edit's query shape) marks each marked App review; history() returns History([], 'an oracle review was edited') when any marked review is edited or its edit state is unreadable, so plan HOLDs. Applies at both call sites (plan cli.py:437 and the guard). (2) The guard's give-up path must not report 'no decision' in a way that bypasses (1): it fails the run instead. (3) On CARRY, cross-check the recorded decision with the App's oracle-verdict status for previous head_sha (success iff SHIP or SHIP WITH FIXES as the status mapping defines); mismatch or unreadable -> HOLD. (4) soundness_merge_digest: count a review as oracle evidence only if unedited and its decision agrees with the App status for that head; otherwise report it as unverifiable. (5) dedup ignores fingerprints from App comments that were edited (read edit state for thread first comments; unreadable -> treat as not deduplicated).

Decision gates:
1. Before coding: one read-only GraphQL query against an existing App review on a merged PR (e.g. #3561) shows lastEditedAt and includesCreatedEdit are returned for a Bot-authored PullRequestReview and for a PullRequestReviewComment. If either field is unavailable for App objects, stop and ask the owner.
2. If the plan job's token cannot run the GraphQL read with its current permissions (pull-requests: read), stop and ask; never widen permissions silently.
3. Before merge: list open PRs to develop whose marked App reviews show includesCreatedEdit=true (read-only). Record the list in context; if non-empty, tell the owner which PRs will HOLD after merge (stand-in is their recovery) before arming.
4. HMAC signing is out of scope (owner decision); it is its own later item.

Item guardrails: fail closed everywhere (edited, unreadable, missing node_id, GraphQL error -> HOLD or error, never carry); do not change gate semantics in oracle_review_check.py beyond what (3)/(4) need; no new secrets; keep one GraphQL round trip per plan where possible (batch by node ids).

Merge freeze (owner 2026-10-27): no oracle-gated PR merges, and no make pr-arm, until oracle-history-edited-review-fail-closed-20261027 is merged; PRs may be opened and reviewed meanwhile. Never edit, delete, dismiss or minimise an oracle review, review comment or commit status, including on test PRs; edit-detection proofs use unit fixtures and read-only GraphQL reads of existing reviews.

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. Never use git stash (refs/stash is shared across worktrees). Commit as Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>, staging explicit paths only; no git add -A, no --no-verify, no SKIP, no agent trailers. Durable text (commits, PR bodies, docs, code) carries no tracker ids, session labels or plan references. Maintained code has no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check). Before publishing run make docs-reference-inventory-check, make doc-contracts-guard and make pr-preflight, and self-review with the code review action, fixing every Critical and Required finding. Publish only with make pr-open: never gh pr create, a raw push-and-open, or a PR-body override line; if make pr-open refuses, stop and report the exact refusal instead of routing around it. Until oracle-omp-pin-single-source-20261026 merges, make pr-open may run only with PATH prefixed by the darwin-arm64 omp 18.12.1 build recorded in that item (SHA-256 fa41b27d434380e99b713e4f9ced0f73eb1fc0c409fdf23a57c119971d24bac5, from https://build.stencil.so/d/omp/20261017-231446-291e055/omp-darwin-arm64), verified with shasum immediately before use; never any other side-loaded omp. Close out only with oracle SHIP on the exact head, every oracle thread answered (reply naming the fixing SHA, then resolve) and make pr-arm; never raw gh pr merge or a ruleset or settings change, and never a stand-in, adjudication or backoff reset unless the owner names the PR and head (and the finding) in the current request after an Owner instruction comment. Never edit, delete, dismiss or minimise an oracle review, review comment or commit status, and never post a commit status by hand. Run /oracle-review only on a pending or absent head, or after a Dispute: reply with file:line counter-evidence; never to re-roll a decided head. Do not close, reopen, rerun or rebase other PRs. Until oracle-gateway-cloud-builder-access-20261025 merges, publish only from the owner's Mac. Rollback: if a change to the verdict or gate workflows or to the local review breaks its first live run after merge in a way that blocks other PRs, stop, run make trunk-revert PR=<n>, and report to the owner, who chooses between an absence stand-in and the broken-oracle-gate procedure. Never print tokens, keys, or the gateway URL or hostname; never spend model quota outside the review harness. Owner decisions are recorded in context and in the decisions file; a step that would contradict one stops and asks the owner.
